summary: get_url's checksum option verifies downloads with algorithm:digest or algorithm:URL and skips re-download if the existing file matches; ciphers sets TLS ciphers.
questions: How do I verify a downloaded file's sha256 with Ansible?
Can get_url read the checksum from a sha256sum.txt URL?
Will get_url skip the download if the file already matches the checksum?
Which checksum algorithm is most portable?

answer_card.title: get_url checksum verification
answer_card.answer_md:
`checksum: "<algo>:<digest|url>"`, e.g. `sha256:D98291AC...` or `sha256:http://example.com/sha256sum.txt`.
- If `dest` exists and matches, download is skipped (unless `force: true`); otherwise it's replaced.
- sha1 is the most portable; md5 may be unavailable under FIPS.
- Checksum URL uses `url_username`/`url_password`.

`ciphers`: list of TLS ciphers.
